content: GHCR: no hard pull rate limits (unlike Docker Hub) for public images; private pulls need PAT with read:packages as dockerconfigjson imagePullSecret; classic PATs don't expire by default but if set to expire, cluster pulls silently break on rotation; packages linked to private repos need repo scope; pulls from outside GitHub Actions count against data transfer/spending limits for private packages. Base images from Docker Hub still rate-limited (200/6h unauth). Sources: GitHub community discussions 49671/160722, dev.to guides.
